collection.title: Volvo XC90 2004 to 2007 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Volvo XC90 2004 to 2007 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 21" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this XC90 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
